title: Bali Honeymoon with Pirate Dinner Cruise
alt: Boats at Tanjung Benoa beach in south Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing, with lunch included.

activities.name: Ubud art market
activities.description: Two floors of carvings, batik, woven bags and silver in the middle of town, quietest and cheapest when the stalls first open.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights inland to start, with a coffee plantation road up to Kintamani, a waterfall stop and the rice terraces at Tegalalang.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Tanjung Benoa and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and one main meal daily · Standard room · 3★ · Quiet pool hotel walking distance from Kuta beach

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage for both of you on your first afternoon in Kuta, warm oil and long pressure strokes at a private spa.

activities.name: Water sports with the pirate dinner cruise
activities.match: Water Sports in Bali with Pirate Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing at Tanjung Benoa by day, then the pirate ship cruise in the evening with dinner and a deck show.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast by speedboat
activities.description: Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach, the island's four best known stops.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast with a couples massage, water sports at Tanjung Benoa, a pirate ship dinner cruise and a full day on Nusa Penida.

day_titles.3: Spa day and on to Kuta

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud resort and settle in
First evening free among the rice fields
Optional: the art market, Goa Gajah or the bird park
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing, with lunch included
3: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to Kuta
Check in and a traditional Balinese massage for two
Dinner at the hotel is included tonight
4: Breakfast, then a morning at Tanjung Benoa beach
Banana boat, jet ski and parasailing with an instructor
Evening pirate ship cruise with dinner and a deck show
Back at the hotel late in the evening
5: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach
Return boat to Bali and dinner at the hotel
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: This is the best value honeymoon we sell. Meals are covered in Kuta, so your spending money goes on the fun.
expert.tip: The pirate cruise is a loud, cheerful evening rather than a romantic one, so we usually put it before the Nusa Penida day and keep your last night free for dinner on the beach.

summary: Six days for two with meals largely covered: two nights in Ubud for Kintamani and the rice terraces, then three in Kuta with a couples massage, water sports at Tanjung Benoa, a pirate ship dinner cruise and a day on Nusa Penida.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; breakfast and one main meal daily in Kuta; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and jungle swing tour with lunch; Balinese massage for two; water sports with the pirate dinner cruise; Nusa Penida west coast tour; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; meals beyond those stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
